Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s Cure 1997 movie is a masterpiece of Japanese horror cinema. Martin Scorsese famously called it one of the most terrifying films ever made, and it’s easy to see why. This brilliant psychological thriller completely skips cheap jump scares, relying instead on pure atmospheric dread and an unsettling detective story to completely mess with your head.

What makes this cult classic cinema so unforgettable is its flawless cinematic screenwriting and chilling acting performance. It tracks an infectious, unexplainable wave of crimes that will leave you questioning your own sense of reality long after the credits roll. If you want a deeply psychological, intellectual nightmare that gets under your skin, this is your immediate sign to watch it.
